name: Classic Pork Fried Rice
desc: Day-old jasmine rice stir-fried with char siu pork, onion, egg and bean sprouts in a light and dark soy sauce.

source.title: Pork Fried Rice
source.evidence: Every ingredient and amount matches the Woks of Life recipe card (5 cups jasmine rice, 1 lb char siu, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 cup bean sprouts, 2 eggs) and the steps follow the same order.

ingredients.raw: 5 cups cooked jasmine rice, preferably day-old (cook it with 1 tsp vegetable oil)
ingredients.note: cook it with 1 tsp vegetable oil

ingredients.raw: 1 tsp vegetable oil, for the eggs
1 lb (450 g) Chinese BBQ pork (char siu), cut into 1/2-inch chunks

steps: Stir together the hot water, honey, sesame oil, Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and white pepper in a small bowl so the sauce is ready before you start cooking.
Fluff the rice with a fork or your hands (wet them with cold water if the rice sticks) until there are no big clumps.
Beat the eggs. Heat the 1 tsp oil in the wok over medium heat, add the eggs, and scramble until softly set, about 1 minute. Transfer to a plate.

Add the 1 tbsp oil to the wok over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent, 3-4 minutes. Stir in the pork, then add the rice and mix well. If the rice is cold from the refrigerator, keep stir-frying until it is heated through, about 5 minutes.
Add the sauce and salt and mix with a scooping motion until the rice is evenly coated, breaking up any remaining clumps. The rice should be hot by now.
Toss in the bean sprouts, scrambled eggs, and scallions and stir-fry 1-2 minutes more. Serve.
tips: Use the Char Siu recipe on this site for the pork, or buy it from a Chinese barbecue shop.
